opennyai_summary.decision:
All office objections to be removed on or before 01.07.2024, failing which, the Petition shall stand dismissed without reference to the Court, on 02.07.2024.
By an interim order, we record that if we finally find that the Petitioner's land has been utilized without following the due procedure laid down in law, we would be directing payment of compensation in accordance with the due procedure laid down under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
